name: johnvc YouTube Transcript & Subtitles API
description: Transcripts, subtitles and captions for YouTube videos and Shorts, timestamped or plain text, in bulk by URL or for a channel's latest videos, with optional translation. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; the tool is the pay-per-video Apify Actor johnvc/YoutubeTranscripts. Sign in with an Apify account (OAuth); videos without captions are not billed.
author: johnvc
